scope: Three fresh noncanonical replacements proposed for ambiguous MA-CASE0506–0508; originals remain immutable

questions.source_basis: Fresh scenario independently authored from the cited official rules; no external question-bank text
questions.scenario: A HIPAA-covered community pharmacy needs to clarify a potentially harmful dose with the patient’s known treating prescriber. No separate state-law restriction applies. At the same time, an unrelated fitness-device company offers to pay the pharmacy for identifiable patient lists to send advertisements. No marketing authorization has been obtained.
questions.lead_in: Which handling appropriately distinguishes the two proposed disclosures? Select ONE answer.
questions.stem:
A HIPAA-covered community pharmacy needs to clarify a potentially harmful dose with the patient’s known treating prescriber. No separate state-law restriction applies. At the same time, an unrelated fitness-device company offers to pay the pharmacy for identifiable patient lists to send advertisements. No marketing authorization has been obtained.

Which handling appropriately distinguishes the two proposed disclosures? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Obtain the patient’s authorization for the dose clarification, and treat the paid advertising list as a business-associate disclosure.
choices.rationale_ko: 적법한 treating-provider 공개는 HIPAA가 별도 authorization을 일반적으로 요구하지 않는다. 회사 자체 광고를 위한 PHI 판매를 약국업무를 대신 수행하는 BA 처리라고 바꿔 부를 수 없다.

choices.text: Clarify the dose with the treating prescriber, and obtain the applicable authorization before releasing the paid advertising list.
choices.rationale_ko: 164.506은 실제 치료를 위한 prescriber 의사소통을 허용한다. 반면 무관한 외부회사 광고·유상 patient-list 공개는 164.508의 marketing/sale authorization을 별도로 확인해야 한다. 자발적 consent가 금지된다는 주장은 아니다.

choices.text: Clarify the dose with the treating prescriber, and release the advertising list once the company promises to keep it confidential.
choices.rationale_ko: 치료 의사소통 부분은 맞지만 일반 비밀유지 약속이 제3자의 광고·PHI 판매에 필요한 환자 authorization을 대신하지 않는다.

choices.text: Obtain the patient’s authorization for both disclosures because an identified patient is involved in each communication.
choices.rationale_ko: 식별 가능한 PHI가 있다는 사실만으로 모든 치료 공개에 authorization이 필수가 되는 것은 아니다. 두 공개의 목적에 따른 허용 경로를 구별해야 한다. 환자의 자발적 consent를 구하는 행위 자체를 금지하는 판단은 아니다.

questions.explanation_ko: 같은 PHI라도 실제 치료를 위한 provider communication과 무관한 회사의 paid marketing은 다른 경로다. 필수가 아닌 authorization을 기다리는 행위 자체의 위법 여부를 묻던 모호성을 제거하고, 어떤 법적 근거가 각 공개를 허용하는지 명시적으로 판단하게 한다.

questions.source_basis: Fresh scenario independently authored from the cited official rules; no external question-bank text
questions.scenario: A patient has agreed that her daughter may collect today’s lisinopril refill and receive information relevant to that pickup. The daughter is not the patient’s personal representative and has no authorization to obtain unrelated records. A separate caller, whose identity is unknown to the pharmacy, requests the patient’s complete medication record and names one of her medications.
questions.lead_in: Which response follows the applicable HIPAA disclosure limits? Select ONE answer.
questions.stem:
A patient has agreed that her daughter may collect today’s lisinopril refill and receive information relevant to that pickup. The daughter is not the patient’s personal representative and has no authorization to obtain unrelated records. A separate caller, whose identity is unknown to the pharmacy, requests the patient’s complete medication record and names one of her medications.

Which response follows the applicable HIPAA disclosure limits? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Provide the daughter the information relevant to pickup, and verify the caller’s identity and authority before releasing the complete record.
choices.rationale_ko: 164.510(b)는 약 수령에 관여하는 가족에게 그 관여에 직접 관련된 정보만 허용한다. 별도 unknown caller의 전체 기록 요구에는 164.514(h)(1)의 identity/authority 확인을 적용한다.

choices.text: Provide the daughter the complete treatment history, and verify the caller’s identity before disclosing the same history by telephone.
choices.rationale_ko: 전화 상대 신원 확인은 맞는 방향이지만 한 처방 pickup 동의는 딸에게 무관한 전체 치료 이력을 주는 근거가 아니다. Personal-representative 지위나 다른 authorization도 없다고 명시되어 있다.

choices.text: Provide the daughter information relevant to pickup, and accept the medication name as sufficient proof of the caller’s access authority.
choices.rationale_ko: 딸에게 관여 관련 정보만 주는 것은 맞다. 그러나 약 이름을 알고 있다는 사실만으로 unknown caller의 신원·전체 기록 접근권한이 확인되는 것은 아니다.

choices.text: Withhold the relevant pickup information from the daughter because HIPAA requires a written authorization for every family-member disclosure.
choices.rationale_ko: 164.510(b)의 관여 관련 공개는 환자의 동의·반대기회·적절한 판단 경로로 가능하다. 현재 환자가 해당 범위에 동의한 사실이 있는데 모든 가족 공개에 written authorization이 필요하다고 일반화하면 틀리다.

questions.explanation_ko: 가족 pickup의 제한된 관여와 전체 기록 접근권한을 분리하고, formal verification을 일률적으로 모든 164.510 공개에 강제하지 않는다. Unknown caller의 전체 기록 요구는 별도 identity/authority 확인 대상이다.

questions.source_basis: Fresh scenario independently authored from the cited official rules; no external question-bank text
questions.scenario: A HIPAA-covered pharmacy received a valid patient-access request 25 calendar days ago. The records are stored with its business associate. The pharmacy cannot complete access within the initial 30-day period and has not used an extension. The patient’s identity is verified, and no denial ground applies.
questions.lead_in: What must the pharmacy do to use the permitted access extension? Select ONE answer.
questions.stem:
A HIPAA-covered pharmacy received a valid patient-access request 25 calendar days ago. The records are stored with its business associate. The pharmacy cannot complete access within the initial 30-day period and has not used an extension. The patient’s identity is verified, and no denial ground applies.

What must the pharmacy do to use the permitted access extension? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Start a new 30-day period when the storage vendor delivers the records to the pharmacy.
choices.rationale_ko: 164.524(b)(2)(i)의 수령 시점에서 이미 시작한 기한을 vendor의 기록 전달로 재시작하는 조항은 없다. 보관 위탁이 clock reset의 근거가 되지 않는다.

authorities.effective_date_or_version: Current eCFR text retrieved2026-11-03; historical amendment effective-date notices not fully retraced for this review

choices.text: Notify the patient after the initial period expires and use successive extensions until the vendor responds.
choices.rationale_ko: 최초 기간 안에 서면 사유·완료 예정일을 알려야 하며 연장은 1회뿐이다. 기간이 지난 뒤 통지하거나 vendor가 응답할 때까지 반복 연장할 수 없다.

authorities.effective_date_or_version: Current eCFR text retrieved2026-11-03; historical amendment effective-date notices not fully retraced for this review

choices.text: Before the initial period ends, give written reasons for the delay and a completion date within one additional period of no more than 30 days.
choices.rationale_ko: 164.524(b)(2)(ii)는 최초 기한 내 written reasons와 완료 예정일을 제공하고 최대 30일을 한 번만 연장하도록 한다. 현재 day25이고 아직 연장을 사용하지 않아 이 절차를 적용할 수 있다.

authorities.effective_date_or_version: Current eCFR text retrieved2026-11-03; historical amendment effective-date notices not fully retraced for this review

choices.text: Treat the vendor’s confidentiality agreement as permission to replace the access deadline with the vendor’s delivery schedule.
choices.rationale_ko: BA의 confidentiality/계약 의무와 환자 access deadline은 별도다. 일반 계약이 164.524의 시한·통지·1회 연장 요건을 없애지 않는다.
